## Policy levels

- `never-modify`: no tool may ever write; no override
- `blocked-until-verified`: denied until the partition is listed in verified-partitions.json AND explicitly authorized
- `explicit-authorization`: requires an explicit per-run authorization naming the partition
- `explicit-destructive-authorization`: requires an explicit per-run destructive authorization naming the partition
